newsitem.title: HONG KONG: TABLE TENNIS-WORLD CUP WOMEN'S ROUND-ROBIN RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: TABLE TENNIS-WORLD CUP WOMEN'S ROUND-ROBIN RESULTS.

text.p: Results of the round-robin group stage of the women's World Cup on Sunday:
Chan Tan-lui (Hong Kong) beat Bose Kaffo (Nigeria) 21-8 21-5
Chai Po-wa (Hong Kong) beat Geng Lijuan (Canada) 21-15 21-15
Ni Xi Lian (Luxembourg) beat Shirley Zhou (Australia) 21-12 21-9
Marie Svensson (Sweden) beat Nicole Struse (Germany), walkover Badescu beat Svensson 21-14 20-22 21-18
Wang Chen (China) beat Park Hae-jung (South Korea) 21-14 21-18
Jing Jun Hong (Singapore) beat Yolanda Rodriguez (Cuba) 21-10 21-6
Quarter-final lineup (matches to be played Sunday evening):
Deng Yaping (China) beat Jing Jun Hong (Singapore) 21-14 21-18
Marie Svensson (Sweden) beat Ni Xia Lian (Luxembourg) 21-19
Yang Ying (China) beat Chan Tan-lui (Hong Kong) 21-10 21-17
Wang Chen (China) beat Chai Po-wa (Hong Kong) 21-19 21-17 21-18
